source.publication: 2025 NJ-1040 Instructions (with GIT-1 & 2 Retirement Income, January 2026, and njit6/njit7 web pages where named)
source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 15, 27, 29: Instr PDF p.15 line 20a nontaxable retirement income ('U.S. Military pensions and survivor's benefit payments'), PDF p.10 exempt income; njit6 Nontaxable Retirement Income ('regardless of your age or disability status'); PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 80,000.00 (spouse 1 U.S. military retired pay 30,000.00 + spouse 2 wages 50,000.00); federal taxable income = 80,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction = 48,500.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). The military pension is exempt and not reported on line 20a (at age 60). Line 15 wages 50,000.00 = line 27 total income 50,000.00 (projection: federal AGI 80,000.00 less the military pension exempt in full 30,000.00). Lines 28a-28b: nobody is 62 or older; exclusions 0.00 and 0.00. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 50,000.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 50,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 2 (nobody is 65 or older, so no senior exemption) = 2,000.00; line 38 = 2,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 50,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 48,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table B (joint/head of household/qualifying widow(er)) as bands: 20,000.00 x 0.014 = 280.00 + 28,000.00 x 0.0175 = 490.00 = 770.00. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 770 for the 48,000-48,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 48,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 770.00. Spouse 1 is presumably an honorably discharged veteran, which on the booklet's line 9 adds a 6,000 veteran exemption (taxable income 42,000, tax 665.00); the projection does not model that exemption and warns (state_rule_not_modelled:nj_veteran_exemption), so expected leaves it out.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
